title: Plan: joint async source/page overlap plus exact CPU fallback batching
source_head_before_experiment: current docs-plan head after this artifact is committed

basis.reason: Raw source-resident topN cannot hit 10 tok/s within VRAM, and CPU microkernel alone cannot hit 10 tok/s. The only remaining paper path combines source/page overlap with a meaningful reduction in hot fallback compute.

required_hard_bound_before_code.source_overlap: Show how much of the 15856.166 ms source/page-exposed saving can be overlapped without increasing TTFT beyond 33617.688744 ms or exceeding 16GB cgroup file cache.
required_hard_bound_before_code.compute_batching: Show whether exact batching/microkernel can save at least 1530.404 ms hot compute with low overhead; larger overhead requires proportionally larger compute saving.
required_hard_bound_before_code.combined_gate: Reject unless combined source overlap plus compute saving exceeds 17386.57 ms decode saving with a realistic overhead budget.

candidate_shapes_to_bound.name: async source/page preparation only
candidate_shapes_to_bound.status: previously rejected as source-only because zero-overhead ceiling was 8.993 tok/s

candidate_shapes_to_bound.name: async source/page preparation plus batched CPU vec_dot scheduling
candidate_shapes_to_bound.goal: reduce hot fallback compute by at least 48.225% after source/page overlap

candidate_shapes_to_bound.name: async source/page preparation plus small Q8_0 GPU assist for hot compute only
candidate_shapes_to_bound.goal: use the combined correctness proof but avoid raw topN residency; must include source movement and sync cost in the bound

rules.must_preserve_correctness: Page timing changes must not change logits; any compute change must pass fixed-text llama-results top1 before performance.
rules.memory: 16GB host RAM includes page cache; MemorySwapMax must remain 0 in all validation/performance runs.
rules.promotion: Any compliant >4.4 tok/s result must be immediately recorded, committed, pushed to ssd/vendor/deepseek-token-rate-16gb, and reproduced from pushed source.
